recording_decision: Recorded the blueprint's way: the fresh receipt and verdicts in this directory, and an appended entry in blueprints/us-equities/engine-nautilus/spy-parity/replay-history-v2.json, whose note requires every v2 execution on the frozen inputs to be listed. No host receipt was recorded: the nautilustrader use receipt for this host (evidence/hosts/nativestack-5975wx-20260925/nativestack-5975wx-20260925--nautilustrader--use--20260925.json, the upstream quickstart) has an independent agree and makes a different claim, so it is not superseded.
corrections: 2026-09-25, after independent review and before merge: harness.checkout named the worktree's local commit, which is not on GitHub; it now names its origin/main base, 720e294b. The C2 prediction is now recorded as wrong. The B2 attribution now says only no_prior_replay_ran_the_reviewed_harness fails by design, and retained_record_before_run fails because the README command omits --review-record. The results themselves and the raw files are unchanged.
limitations: One case (one_zero), one replay pair, one host; CPU only.
A reproduction of a published result, not a new qualification: gate G-a and every catalog status are unchanged, and receipt-v2.json and verdict-v2.json stay the published v2 result.
The converted rows and the raw engine reports and logs stay private in the scratch run directory, as the README directs; their sha256 values are in the fresh receipt.
Only one input was altered for the negative control; each of the five inputs is checked by the same verify_inputs loop in convert.py.

The README's --bars example (under 'Reproduce verdict.json') exits 1 on both v2 receipts here (C on receipt-v2.json, B on this host's receipt): --bars cannot re-hash the five inputs, and v2 counts that skipped check as FAIL. Only --lean-data passed (C2).

Sanitization: in preregistration.txt and negative-tampered-bars.stderr.txt the scratch directory is written as <scratch>/spy-parity-run and the home directory as ~. The other raw files are byte-identical to the run outputs.
